name: clone-any-site
description: Clone any website to pixel-perfect fidelity on loopback, then repurpose it as your own by keep-or-swapping numbered elements — visually. Text edits stick + propagate to every matching instance; media swaps keep srcset; Cmd-K command palette + searchable CMS panel + find-replace + 1-click themes. Includes /clone-list, a dashboard to preview, launch, edit, and retire all your clones. Handles WebGL/3D scroll sites, not just static pages.
